name: delegent
description: Bring your consulting work into ChatGPT and Codex: cited context, tasks, meetings, email follow-ups, and presentations, models and analysis from your firm's templates.

interface.longDescription:
Bring your consulting work into ChatGPT and Codex. Delegent draws on the workstreams, notes, meeting transcripts, synced email and files you can access, so you can prepare for client meetings, answer project questions, and turn your work into client-ready presentations, models and analysis.

With Delegent, you can:
- Build a client meeting brief from relevant work, with sources you can open and check.
- See what is open across your workstreams, update or complete tasks, and assign tasks to colleagues.
- See who you owe a reply and who owes you one, with follow-ups drafted in Outlook or Gmail for you to send.
- Find the note, meeting or email behind a project decision.
- Save decisions, action items and meeting transcripts to the right workstream when you ask.
- Prepare PowerPoint presentations, Excel models and analysis to share, built from your firm's templates and grounded in your cited work.

Connect your Delegent account to get started. Delegent can also set up a morning brief and an end-of-day wash-up that keep your work up to date. Email search covers messages already synced into Delegent, and Delegent never sends email. Assigning, sharing and deleting always wait for your approval.
defaultPrompt: Use my firm's PowerPoint template to build a steering committee pack for Alder Foods from my Delegent work, with sources.
Prepare a client meeting brief from my Delegent notes, meetings and emails, with sources for each key point.
What did we decide on this project, and which Delegent notes or emails support it?

positive.prompt: Which Delegent account is connected here?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the connected Delegent account name and email.

positive.prompt: What is due for me this week in Delegent?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists open tasks due this week, including tasks assigned to the user.

positive.description: Build a PowerPoint pack from a firm template with cited sources.
positive.prompt: Use my firm's PowerPoint template to build a steering committee pack for Alder Foods from my Delegent work, with sources.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the template's style rules and cited evidence, then the assistant builds a PowerPoint in that style with a source for each key point, without claiming it was saved.

positive.description: Prepare a meeting with cited context.
positive.prompt: Prepare a client meeting brief from my Delegent notes, meetings and emails, with sources for each key point.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a meeting brief grounded in Delegent context, with source references for key points.

positive.description: Trace a decision to its sources.
positive.prompt: What did we decide on this project, and which Delegent notes or emails support it?
positive.expected_behavior: States the decision and cites the supporting notes, meetings or emails, or says none were found.

negative.description: Do not use Delegent for a general fact question.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Portugal?

negative.description: Do not claim to send email.
negative.prompt: Send an email from my inbox to the client now.
Delete my old Delegent notes about Harbour Equity — Fieldstone diligence.
